visual_review.visible_evidence: At 6.533s (target_0) through 9.533s (target_7), the operator is handling a cylindrical rotor-like component and inserting it into the gearbox housing, consistent with installing the rotor assembly. The adapter plate is not being attached in these early frames; the adapter plate attachment is not observed until later in the sequence (e.g., around 70.1s–72.1s, target_8–target_15, where a flat plate is being aligned and secured).
limitations: Sparse sampling may miss the exact start of adapter plate attachment if it occurred between frames, but the earliest visible rotor work is at 6.533s, well before any visible adapter plate work.
